## ctxloom bundle delete

Delete a bundle

### Synopsis

Delete a bundle from the local .ctxloom/content/bundles directory.

This permanently removes the bundle file. Use --force to skip confirmation.

Examples:
  ctxloom bundle delete old-bundle
  ctxloom bundle delete my-bundle --force

```
ctxloom bundle delete <name> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -f, --force   Skip confirmation prompt
```
